# 2. How the groups must NOT be represented

- not as eight direct individual acceptances
- not as eight fully unanswered decisions
- not as eight pending-human blockers

Each of those three is a different way of losing information. *Eight individual acceptances* invents ticks that are not on the page. *Eight unanswered decisions* discards a set-level acceptance she did write. *Eight pending-human blockers* would stall a build over a question the authority has already answered.
